description: This file is a PHP class test script for the 'testsuite' class used in the TestLink project. It demonstrates usage of various methods of the 'testsuite' class, such as retrieving test suites by name, ID, getting test cases, keywords, linked custom fields, and generating HTML tables for custom field inputs and values. The script primarily serves as a test harness and example usage for the 'testsuite' class.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: The 'testsuite' class manages test suite data, providing methods to retrieve test suite information, associated test cases, keywords, custom fields, and generating related HTML views.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a test suite by its name.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Retrieves child test suites or test cases of a given test suite ID.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a test suite by its ID.

methods.name: get_testcases_deep
methods.description: Retrieves all test cases under a test suite, optionally with detailed information.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Fetches keywords associated with a test suite.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Maps keywords for a given test suite ID.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_design
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields linked at design time for a test suite.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_execution
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields linked at execution time for a test suite.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom field input forms.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom field values.
